listen_address.description: Local IP address the DNS-over-HTTPS proxy binds to.

listen_port.description: Local port to accept standard DNS queries (typically 53 for UDP/TCP).

upstream_resolvers.description: List of DoH resolvers to forward queries to (supports multiple for fallback).

bootstrap.description: Optional bootstrap DNS IP (e.g., '8.8.8.8') to resolve the resolver's hostname.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for this resolver.

prefer_ipv6.description: Whether to prefer IPv6 for backend connections to this resolver.

path.description: File path for the log file.

max_age_days.description: Maximum age (in days) before log rotation purges old entries.

max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size (in MB) before rotation.

rate_limit.description: Rate-limiting rules per client IP to prevent abuse.

requests_per_minute.description: Max number of queries allowed per minute per client IP.

burst_size.description: Maximum burst (extra queries) before throttling kicks in.

whitelist.description: List of IPs/subnets exempt from rate limiting.

min_ttl.description: Minimum cache TTL in seconds (overrides low TTL values).

max_ttl.description: Maximum cache TTL in seconds (caps high TTL values).

block_malicious.description: Block queries to known malicious domains using blocklists.

block_list_urls.description: List of URLs to fetch malicious domain blocklists from (supports static hosts or plain domain lists).

edns_client_subnet.description: Forward client subnet info to upstream resolver (use cautiously for privacy).

tcp_idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) for persistent TCP connections to upstream resolvers.
